_about: Comfort-routing harness start points (docs/COMFORT-ROUTING-SPEC.md §5 Phase 0B). PROPOSED 2026-11-02, awaiting Travis's confirmation. Coordinates are canonical [lng, lat], approximate town/area centres; the harness snaps each to the nearest routable way before generating. 'expect' is a prior for sanity-checking the baseline, not an assertion.

points.why: Dense path network (Boulder Creek, Goose Creek) beside fast arterials (28th, Canyon, US-36).
points.expect: ok at every level

points.why: Bike-lane grid plus Cherry Creek trail; arterials (Downing, University, Colorado Blvd) to cross.
points.expect: ok; flagged crossings at L1

points.why: West-side urban, Federal/Sheridan arterials, I-25/I-70 barriers.
points.expect: ok at L2+; tests barrier crossings

points.why: Strong bike network (Spring Creek, Poudre trails) and a well-tagged city.
points.expect: ok at every level; best-case tag coverage

points.why: Arterial-heavy grid (Sheridan, 104th, US-36); the classic 'only fast roads connect' suburb.
points.expect: alternatives likely at L1–L2

points.why: Six-lane arterial grid (E-470, Arapahoe, Gun Club) with cul-de-sac neighbourhoods.
points.expect: alternatives/refused at L1–L2

points.why: Planned suburb: good internal paths, fast boundary roads (C-470, Santa Fe, Broadway).
points.expect: ok at short distances; harder at 50–75 mi

points.why: Small-town core with Coal Creek trail; South Boulder Rd and 96th as the fast links.
points.expect: ok at L2+

points.why: Fast-growing exurb on the edge of county roads; already the brouter validate-profiles origin.
points.expect: ok at L3+; tests unknown-speed county roads

points.why: Popular road-ride hub; quiet county roads mixed with CO-66 / US-36.
points.expect: ok at L2+; many unknown-speed roads

points.why: Paved county grid between US-287 and I-25; few roads have maxspeed.
points.expect: high unknown_pct; key test of the flag-not-block rule

points.why: Weld County plains: US-85, fast straight paved county roads, oil-field traffic.
points.expect: alternatives/refused at L1–L2

points.why: Eastern plains on the I-70 corridor; sparse network, few loop options.
points.expect: refused at L1–L2 at 50–75 mi; tests nearby-start search

points.why: Canyon gateway: US-36 and CO-7 are the only ways in and out, with shoulders that come and go.
points.expect: flagged stretches common at L3; refused at L1

points.why: Lookout Mtn and Clear Creek trail beside US-6 / CO-93 (bikes legal, fast).
points.expect: ok at L2+ short; tests class-5 avoidance

points.why: Red Rocks and Bear Creek Canyon (CO-74); a choke point between hills and suburbs.
points.expect: flagged at L2–L3

points.why: Mountain town: CO-119 / CO-72 only, plus dirt roads.
points.expect: refused on road at L1–L3; ok on gravel

points.why: Buckhorn / Rist Canyon gravel network west of Loveland.
points.expect: ok on gravel at every level; tests the unpaved cap

points.why: Northern Larimer grid of unpaved county roads.
points.expect: ok on gravel; road surface mostly unknown-speed paved

points.why: Elbert County gravel with CO-86 as the paved spine.
points.expect: ok on gravel; tests flagged state-highway crossings
